title: [Lean] Check original PR1942 chart witnesses and strict envelope
body:
## Summary

Publish four unchanged, independently accepted Lean 4.21.0 sources:
- Original bounded five-array witness completeness through the existing Value, Json and named-dictionary checks.
- Strict PR1942 format/dimension/entries selection and the same-key checker call.
- A direct join deriving wrapper success from the original finite checks and five named-field equations.
- One source-matched L450 application preserving the original five 73-element arrays, reusing the accepted scalar certificate.

Author-checked contextual κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918 at exact selected-source context 299eb8effe080183313757ac36e76c1b98ed9fae. The generic results do not use or change κ; this does not prove the full multiplication theorem.

## Evidence and reuse

The four accepted sources total 26,633 bytes and expose 16 clean standard-only axiom probes and seven complete printed types. Public source-bound acceptance summaries, exact hashes and bounded prospective reproduction commands are included. All 94 public prerequisites are referenced by immutable source identity, including PR2371's exact FragmentData; none is copied. No compiler, parser diagnostic, Python verifier or witness census was rerun for this handoff.

The original PR1942 donor is c7d8c9febf0fcc52d2002db657165cd206ff9cec. The exact 1,627-byte selected excerpt and compressed/decompressed identity records are included with attribution to Adam Gall with OpenAI assistance. All original source attribution is retained.

## Explicit scope

The selected theorem retains all five original named-field AST equations. Whole-file parsing, opaque logical Json.parse equations, artifact authentication, general duplicate-key or lexical policy, complex phases, physical execution and costs remain separate. The excerpt-to-source correspondence is independently source-reviewed rather than a Lean filesystem/parser theorem. The newer constructed single-entry follow-on is excluded.

## Exact adoption

Publication parent: 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2. The five selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter blobs match the previously checked context exactly; contextual kappa is unchanged. No accepted proof was rerun for this adoption.
